findings: The same fixed p1 direction is present in NS73 and NS90–93/98; NS92 S_N is a stronger sufficient cost, not an equal cost.
The numerator and cost must be compatible; proving only a cost bound would not close the route.
Different selected directions, full blocks, smoothing orders and N-to-N² restrictions share a broad convergence objective, not identical arithmetic sums.
CAE, adaptive concentration, critical Clifford domination and coefficient-one localization share a second exact signed-floor family under their domain hypotheses.
Kernel API, CCM selection/transform control, level/packet complexity, canonical growth, upper-error sums, continuous closure and geometry are not identified with the NS98 estimate.
The old generator statement that only live nodes are worth working on was unsupported and removed.
No theorem node, theorem-status change, new version or recovered historical evidence.
